note: WP-16: palette variants per scene. A shot with "palette_variant": <name> recolours its characters (every palette colour and every literal colour in their drawings) the same way in every renderer: desaturate toward grey by desat, mix toward tint by tint_amt, multiply each channel by mult, clamp, round. Raster parts (photos, scans) are not recoloured.
